name: Spotlight Card
description: The card surface lights up under the cursor; a soft circular light follows you, the card edge blocks the light, and pressing expands it.
interactionNotes: The light wakes up when the cursor approaches from outside the card (within the card's outer reach, in pixels) and follows the cursor inside the card; pressing expands it and makes it brighter. It is alive with the keyboard too: any focusable element inside the card with `:focus-visible` draws the light toward itself. With `prefers-reduced-motion` the light settles instantly and the ambient drift turns off.

props.name: spotlightColor
props.description: Light color; any valid CSS color is accepted and its alpha is read too. It defaults to white on a dark card and near-black ink on a light card.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the light on the card surface; 0 to 1.

props.name: softness
props.description: How soft the light's falloff is; 0 gives a sharp disc and 1 a halo that fades from the very center.

props.name: shape
props.description: A circle is a round light around the cursor; a beam pours from the card's top edge toward the cursor like stage light.

props.name: borderGlow
props.description: How much the card edge glows near the light; 0 to 1.

props.name: proximity
props.description: The distance outside the card from which the light reaches for it, pixels. Adjacent cards share this one light; zero means it only lights on hover.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How much the light lags behind the cursor; zero means glued to the cursor.

props.name: ambient
props.description: When nobody points at the card, the light wanders slowly across the surface — to keep the card alive on touch screens.

props.name: flare
props.description: Pressing the card makes the light bigger and brighter.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain inside the light; 0 to 1. A little of it kills the banding of large soft gradients.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface, border and light behavior for a dark or light page. You can also override the colors from outside with the `--spotlight-card-surface` and `--spotlight-card-border` variables.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: The remaining div props — like `onClick`, `id` and `aria` — go straight to the card.

tips: This component **doesn't mirror in right-to-left and doesn't need to**: the light's position is the cursor's physical coordinates, which mean the same in RTL; Persian text inside the card lays itself out RTL automatically.
The magic of `proximity` is in rows: several adjacent cards with the same defaults share one light — one cursor wakes all the neighbors, like a storefront that lights up as you approach.
`ambient` is for cards that can't be touched (mobile and non-interactive previews): the light wanders slowly on its own so the card doesn't look dead.
On large, soft gradients, a little `grain` (0.3 to 0.4) kills the color banding; `softness` zero also gives a sharp disc, which with `grain` looks cinematic.
Keyboard accessibility is built in: anything inside the card that takes `:focus-visible` gets the light — keyboard users see the light's path too.

The default light color is theme-aware: white on a dark card and dark ink on a light card; if you gave a custom color and it looks weak in a light theme, remember the light is multiplied by 0.28 on a white surface and appears softer.
